summary: The checkpoint of Module 14: the assistant answers through a model on your own machine chosen by configuration, a script runs the same retrieval and prompt with different writers, and a table shows your five questions on two models plus the stand-in with pass, time, memory and cost. The decision rests on small numbers and says so, and notes explain why a model server stays behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
goal: M14 checkpoint: a table of 5 questions on 2 models; HTTPS and reverse proxy notes.

items.text: Start a model server, warm it up and ask one question through the API
Run compare_models.py on the five questions with two models and the stand-in
Run the 18 questions and add the time, memory and first-call columns
Work out the cost of 1000 questions from two real rows of the requests table
Write the decision with your numbers and what you would test next
Write the notes on HTTPS, a reverse proxy and who may call the model
Play the Model Comparison game to the end and see your score
